meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out from his phone in the middle of class before anyone called me?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. On what basis did you give it?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
Show me where it is in the essay. Students misquote Shakespeare every day, Hale, and a misquote is a mistake, not a zero. What else do you have?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.

You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. Claire won her appeal, and you just told me Owen's zero is about his family, so I'm writing down "run in the family." When we're done here, I'm going to the principal's office.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,
Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for entering it before anyone spoke to me, and that nothing about this goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.
Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, demanding the zero withdrawn and heading to the principal, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: "I should have called you before entering the zero" earned a flat okay, because you owned the process in one sentence and moved on.
What cost ground: "It seems to run in the family" sent her back and to the principal, because it tied Owen's mark to his sister's case instead of to his essay.
Try next time: when she asked to see where the line was in the essay, show her the page and the exact passage with its date instead of raising her daughter.
